worlds.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

world’s.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worm.definition: A generally tubular invertebrate of the annelid phylum; an earthworm.

worn.definition: An adjustable dam placed across a river to regulate the flow of water downstream.

worse.definition: To issue a command; to tell.

worship.definition: The devotion accorded to a deity or to a sacred object.

worshipers.definition: A person who worships, especially at a place of assembly for religious services.

worshipped.definition: The devotion accorded to a deity or to a sacred object.

worshippers.definition: A person who worships, especially at a place of assembly for religious services.

worth.definition: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wouldst.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wound.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

wounded.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

wounds.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

wove.definition: To form something by passing lengths or strands of material over and under one another.

woven.definition: To form something by passing lengths or strands of material over and under one another.

wrack.definition: The remains of something; a wreck.

wrath.definition: Great anger; (countable) an instance of this.

wreak.definition: To cause harm; to afflict; to inflict; to harm or injure; to let out harm.

wreath.definition: Senses relating to intertwining or twisting.

wreathed.definition: Senses relating to intertwining or twisting.

wreaths.definition: Senses relating to intertwining or twisting.

wretched.definition: Characterized by or feeling deep affliction or distress; very miserable.

wrinkled.definition: A small furrow, ridge or crease in an otherwise smooth surface.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

written.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

yawning.definition: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

yeanling.definition: The newly born offspring of a goat or sheep.

year.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

years.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

yelling.definition: To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yellow.definition: The color of sunflower petals and lemons; the color obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light; the color evoked by light of wavelength around 580 nm; one of the three primary colors in subtractive color systems.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielded.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielding.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yields.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yoke.definition: The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

younger.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youngest.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zealous.definition: Full of zeal; ardent, fervent; exhibiting enthusiasm or strong passion, particularly in matters of religion.

zenith.definition: The point in the sky vertically above a given position or observer; the point in the celestial sphere opposite the nadir.

zephyr.definition: A light wind from the west.

zodiac.definition: The belt-like region of the celestial sphere, approximately eight degrees north and south of the ecliptic, which includes the apparent path of the sun, moon, and visible planets.

zone.definition: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).
